name: Orchestrator demo help
description: The Orchestrator demo's Help mode entries (help@1): the page, the start overlay, the caption bar, the summary and the settings.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Orchestrator demo
entries.text: A guided live tour of the Build orchestrator on throwaway demo builds: queue, launch, steps crossed off one by one, a crash caught by the watchdog and retried, red CI fixed, merge-main, a dry-run landing, a build that dies for good with its break alert, cleanup and a phone notification. This page shows every act crossed off as it goes (✓ pass, ✗ fail with what failed, – skipped). Real builds are never touched.

entries.title: Start the demo
entries.text: Opens the start overlay: what the demo will do, the Pause between steps switch, and Continue / Pause / Stop. Same as `axf demo orchestrator start`, POST /api/plugins/orchestrator-demo/start, or saying "start the orchestrator demo".

entries.title: Pause between steps
entries.text: On: after each act the demo stays on what to watch until you press Next, then waits 30 s and brings you to the next one. Off: it plays on by itself with at least 30 s between acts.

entries.title: Pause between steps (default)
entries.text: What a new demo run starts with. Changing it also changes a run that is playing now. The gap between acts is fixed at 30 s minimum and can't be lowered.

entries.title: Open the start overlay
entries.text: Opens the Orchestrator demo's start overlay, where you start or pause the demo. Deep link: ?axf-open=orchestrator-demo.

entries.title: Orchestrator demo
entries.text: Settings of the guided Orchestrator demo: the default for Pause between steps, the 30 s minimum gap, install and uninstall.

entries.title: Continue
entries.text: Starts the demo with the Pause between steps choice above. The console is brought to the first thing to watch and a caption says what is about to happen.

entries.title: Next
entries.text: Leaves the act you are looking at. The next act is focused after the 30 s gap.

entries.title: Skip
entries.text: Skips the current act; it is recorded as skipped in the summary.

entries.title: Run again
entries.text: Opens the start overlay for a new demo run. The last run's summary stays readable with `axf demo orchestrator summary`.

entries.title: Start the orchestrator demo
entries.text: Opens the demo's start overlay: Continue plays the guided run on throwaway demo builds, Pause opens it held at the first act.

entries.title: Orchestrator demo summary
entries.text: Opens the summary of the last demo run: every act with pass, fail or skipped, and what failed.
